title: wasm-acceptor-harness suite
description: A suite of tools/wasm-acceptor-harness: component artifacts (pinned by SHA-256, with the Lean claims made about exactly those bytes) and the cases run on them under Wasmtime. Arguments are converted by the export's actual parameter types; see tools/wasm-acceptor-harness/README.md for the JSON shape of each WIT type.

suite.description: The suite's name; artifact ids in the report are `<suite>/<artifact>`

path.description: The component file, relative to the suite file

sha256.description: The pinned SHA-256: a different file is an `error` for every case and gets no claims

source.description: What the artifact is (for example the Lean value it is generated from)

claims.description: What the Lean library states about exactly the pinned bytes; needs `sha256`. Copied into the report, not checked by the harness.

kind.description: The kind of claim as shown, e.g. `component-level soundness (kernel-checked)` or `core-module soundness only`

level.description: `component`: about every reference Component Model reading of the bytes; `core-module`: about the core module inside only

registry_name.description: The name the bytes are registered under in silmaril/artifacts.toml

value.description: The Lean value the bytes are regenerated from, e.g. `Silmaril.Wasm.Examples.SatAccept.bytes`

scope.description: What the theorems cover and what they leave out

artifact.description: An artifact id of this suite

export.description: The exported function; it must return one `bool`

args.description: Positional arguments, one JSON value per parameter, converted by the parameter's type

expect_detail.description: A substring the observed detail (trap or error message) must contain; needs `expect`
